# MGPL Report Studio

> Next.js 16 app (App Router) that previews MGPL Diagnostics lab reports, the letterhead and patient invoices, and serves A4 PDFs rendered in Node.js by @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit and @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit. It is the reference integration for using the kits in other Next.js apps.

Key facts for agents:
- No rendering logic here; change the kits instead.
- PDF routes: `/api/report-pdf`, `/api/letterhead-pdf`, `/api/invoice-pdf` (GET samples, POST arbitrary JSON); `runtime = "nodejs"`.
- Required config: `serverExternalPackages: ["@react-pdf/renderer", "@resvg/resvg-js"]`; `postinstall: mgpl-report-assets public`.
